n8f379d1911.headline: Czech debt rose to 2.09 trillion. Mainly due to mortgages - Novinky
n8f379d1911.summary: Czech residents' total debt reached 2.09 trillion crowns by Q3, up 172.9 billion year-on-year, mainly due to a 9.9% rise in housing loan debt.
n8f379d1911.why: Household debt levels impact consumer spending and financial stability, with mortgage growth indicating housing market trends.

n4c79d917f2.headline: The City Palais building in central Prague was bought for a billion by Redevco - Novinky
n4c79d917f2.summary: International investment firm Redevco purchased the City Palais building in central Prague for more than 40 million euros, with plans for commercial use.
n4c79d917f2.why: Large real estate acquisitions by international investors indicate confidence in local commercial property markets and can influence regional economic activity.
